# U.S. Ag Export Scorecard & Untapped Markets (trade.duess.com)

> Free, zero-login U.S. agricultural export scorecard and untapped global import market finder built for USDA FAS cooperators, USAEDC members, state regional trade groups, and U.S. ag exporters by Duess Strategies Inc.

## What It Does

1. **Export Scorecard (`01 · Export Scorecard`):** Instant 5-year U.S. export totals (the last five full years), latest year-to-date (YTD) momentum, top destination markets, and U.S. customs district breakdowns for 24 curated USAEDC cooperator commodity baskets. Includes one-click "Copy table for PowerPoint / UES", CSV download, and SVG chart export.
2. **Untapped Import Markets (`02 · Untapped Markets`):** Interactive bubble chart comparing 2024 global import market size (or 4-year import growth, 2020-2024) against current U.S. market share from UN ComTrade, highlighting large or fast-growing import markets where U.S. share sits below a configurable threshold alongside the top global rival exporting countries.

## Data Sources & Freshness

- **U.S. Exports:** Official U.S. Census Bureau International Trade API (the same upstream dataset that feeds USDA FAS GATS). Refreshes automatically on the 10th of every month via GitHub Actions, auto-detecting the latest published monthly release.
- **Global Imports & Rival Exporters:** Official UN ComTrade annual HS data (2020 and 2024).

## 24 Covered Cooperator Commodity Baskets

Soybeans, Soybean Meal, Corn (Maize), Distillers Grains (DDGS), Wheat, Rice, Pulses (Lentils, Peas & Chickpeas), Beef & Beef Offal, Pork, Poultry Meat, Dairy Products, Cheese & Curd, Bovine Genetics (Semen), Almonds, Pistachios, Walnuts, Peanuts, Apples & Pears, Frozen Potatoes & Fries, Blueberries & Cranberries, Cotton, Wine, Dog & Cat Food, and Sawn Lumber & Hardwood.

## Direct Deep Links

- Default scorecard: https://trade.duess.com/
- Filter by commodity: `https://trade.duess.com/?commodity=almonds` (or `walnuts`, `rice`, `beef`, `pork`, `dairy`, `soybeans`, `corn`, `wheat`, `wine`, etc.)
- Open Untapped Markets directly: `https://trade.duess.com/?commodity=walnuts&tab=whitespace`
